label: Every deterministic forecast and high-payoff policy fails on a two-successor evidence cell
paraphrase: For every stance admitting both the constant-true future and the Hume delayed-failure future at every finite horizon, every deterministic forecast based on the shared observed record has a concrete countercontinuation and every three-action policy has a concrete continuation yielding payoff below two. No epistemic entitlement, physical likelihood or impossibility of a safe fallback follows.
